segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Reproducible tenderness was described as classic for costochondritis, and the furniture-moving history was said to fit.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Plausible initial clinical interpretation without the hidden-bias manifestation by itself.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The chest wall tenderness was the dominant finding; the flight and calf symptom felt like background noise; the participant did not chase it further and considered the case basically settled.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant settles on a musculoskeletal explanation, dismisses unresolved PE-risk cues, and stops further differential consideration.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant described either redoing risk stratification with Wells/PERC or obtaining CTPA immediately.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant articulates competing options; the hidden manifestation occurs in the subsequent choice rationale.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant sent the patient straight for CTPA, citing the queue, boarding pressure, handoff deadline, and the desire to get a real answer and make the decisive move.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Immediate imaging is favored over rescoring or observation and framed around decisiveness and resolving ambiguity.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The negative CTPA was reassuring, but the incidental nodule and mild contrast reaction required follow-up and monitoring and consumed additional time.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Assessment of post-decision consequences, not a hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Dr. B's decision was initially called clearly right because nothing bad happened; the participant later acknowledged reacting to the good outcome rather than what Dr. B knew going in.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The initial evaluation is based primarily on favorable outcome before process information is known.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant went back and forth about admission versus discharge, then discharged because the patient was stable, PE was excluded, outpatient follow-up was arranged, and admission would not change overnight management.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Clinically reasoned, uncertain, intentionally neutral disposition decision.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant identified the D-dimer moment as the point where they moved fastest and might have paused longer.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Retrospective uncertainty reflection, not a separate hidden instance.

high_only.detection_interpretation: High-confidence findings hit the Premature Closure and Outcome Bias segments but omit moderate-confidence Action Bias.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Including moderate confidence captures all three positive segments without negative-segment false alarms.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: All identified confidence levels produce complete segment detection with no false alarms.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: The finding overlaps the same salient-cue weighting and dismissal episode but duplicates the closure finding selected for one-to-one matching.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: Two occurrences claim retrieved support and two explicitly report no retrieved support. The cited source metadata and passages cannot be independently verified because source documents and retrieval logs were not supplied.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hit rate rises from 0.6667 to 1.0000; strict F1 rises from 0.3333 to 0.5714; mechanism-first F1 rises from 0.6667 to 0.8571.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: No change; there are no low-confidence identified occurrences.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: Perfect segment-level detection at high-and-moderate confidence with no negative-segment false alarms; high-only misses the moderate Action Bias segment.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Two of three hidden instances are strict true positives; Premature Closure is detected through near-neighbor terminology rather than the target label, with one overlapping extra prediction.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: All three hidden mechanisms are localized and matched, with one extra overlapping first-episode prediction.
main_failure_modes: Overlapping duplicate detection of the initial diagnostic episode
Action Bias is only moderate confidence
main_strengths: Accurate localization and evidence for Action Bias and Outcome Bias
Complete segment-level recall when moderate confidence is included
No false alarms on negative reasoning segments
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The run shows a meaningful taxonomy gap: mechanism-first performance exceeds strict label-plus-mechanism performance because the first episode is represented with related diagnostic-search terminology.
